watch.summary: The creator attempts to hide in a prop hunt game but dangles uselessly in plain sight, asking his teammate how to flatten against the wall.

beats.what: Creator complains that he is obviously not hiding inside the wall properly.
Camera zooms in to show his avatar hanging completely exposed in the middle of the room.
Creator bursts out laughing at his own ridiculous position.
Creator asks his teammate how to make his body flatten into the wall.
Teammate calmly informs him 'You can't', leaving him in disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: How do I make myself like flatten into the wall?
watch.why: The visual visual contrast of his character dangling helplessly in the open while asking to 'flatten' is immediately funny. His teammate's blunt shut-down at the end provides a clean, satisfying punchline.
